shots.note: medium push_in: Agni, ember-skinned with his flame crown and fire halo, stands behind a blazing brick fire altar in a bright village yard below the title card and opens his arms over the flames on 'fire'.
medium dolly_right: A village man stands at the altar and pours an offering into the fire; as he says the last word the flames flare gold and the name 'Swaha' appears above.
high_angle crane_down: High and wide over a pale, empty hall of heaven: three thin gods sit slumped on the clouds between faded pillars, heads hanging.
two_shot static: Stacked: above, a thin god in pale heaven looks down with sad eyes; below, on bright earth, a villager pours offerings into a blazing fire altar.
close push_in: Close on Agni with folded hands: his fire halo burns low and on 'fault' he lowers his eyes and bows his head in shame.
two_shot pan_right: Morning sun over the gold hall of heaven: two thin gods walk in from the left and the window pans with them to four-headed Brahma on his lotus, who looks up as his name is said.
establishing crane_up: Wide on Brahmaloka: a gold gateway stands on the clouds, Brahma sits on his pink lotus before it, and the name plate appears as 'Brahmaloka' is said.
two_shot push_in: Two thin gods in faded cloth stand close together; one sags on 'weak', and on 'nothing' both open their empty hands to Brahma.
medium dolly_left: Brahma on his lotus speaks with an open teaching hand, his Veda book at his side and a soft gold ring of light behind his heads.
wide crane_down: Bright earth: a village man and woman stand facing each other across a blazing brick fire altar in their yard, hands folded, and the word 'Yajna' appears above the fire.
medium push_in: Closer: the village woman stretches both hands over the altar and a stream of round gold offering-motes falls from her hands into the flames, which flare up on 'fire'.
medium tilt_up: Agni rises out of the altar fire, arms open to receive, his flame crown blazing; the name 'Agni' appears above him.

wide pull_out: A column of light rises from the altar fire at the bottom of the frame to the gold gateway of Brahmaloka in the clouds at the top; Agni rides up the column with raised arms and gold offering-motes climb past him to the gate.
two_shot tilt_down: Stacked: above, a god in bright heaven raises a blessing hand; below, the villager at his fire folds his hands with joy as warm rays fall on him.
medium crane_up: Thin Indra, still in his tall crown with his vajra, stands in the pale hall with a dimmed blue halo; his name appears as it is said.
medium dolly_right: Indra points down toward earth as he speaks; far below the clouds three little columns of yajna smoke rise from the villages, proof that the rituals go on.
wide tilt_up: Above, a thin god sits on a cloud with an empty gaze looking down; below, the smoke and gold motes rising from an earth altar thin out and vanish into a gray mist halfway up.
medium push_in: Kamadev in a rose dhoti and parrot-green shawl, his sugarcane bow in hand, turns with a proud, sharp look as his name appears.
two_shot handheld: Stacked: above, Kamadev jabs a finger downward in anger; below, Agni hears the charge and lowers his eyes in shame.
medium dolly_right: Agni walks forward out of the group of thin gods, palms folded; the gods behind him turn their eyes to him.
close push_in: Close on Agni's face: he speaks with his eyes lowered and his head bowed, owning the fault.
medium pull_out: Agni stands over a roaring altar fire with an open hand: the flames leap high and the offerings burn bright gold.
medium tilt_up: Agni looks up and lifts his hands as gold offering-motes drift up from him and fade out in the empty sky; on 'skill' he drops his eyes in sorrow.
close static: Brahma on his lotus sits silent and still with a troubled frown, his eyes lowered; the gold light of his hall cools on 'answer'.
medium tilt_down: Blue four-armed Vishnu appears in a ring of light in the gold hall and opens his hand; his name appears as it is said.
two_shot crane_down: Stacked: above, Vishnu speaks and points the way; below, Brahma on his lotus folds his hands in prayer while a green light of Mother Nature glows around him on 'Prakriti'.
two_shot pan_right: In a green flowering world Prakriti opens her hands and, in a burst of warm light beside her, the young goddess Swaha in a flame-orange sari takes shape.

wide crane_up: The road of light again, now complete: Swaha rises up the column of light from the altar fire, arms raised, and the gold offering-motes she carries reach the shining gateway of Brahmaloka at the top.
medium dolly_left: Brahma on his lotus leans toward the right with an open, welcoming hand and a curious smile as he asks.
close push_in: Close on Swaha: a gentle smile as she says her own name, her small fire halo glowing, and the name 'Swaha' appears above her.
medium tilt_up: Brahma, standing between Agni and Swaha, raises his hand to proclaim the rule; Agni folds his hands on his name and Swaha on 'name', as a gold ring of light opens behind Brahma.
medium pull_out: On earth the village woman pours into the fire, but the motes rise only a little and thin into gray smoke; she looks up, doubtful.
medium push_in: Brahma stands with one finger raised as he speaks the comparison, his face stern and certain.
wide tilt_down: A lone tree stands on a pale bare field: green leaves but not a single fruit or flower on it, under a quiet sky.
medium dolly_left: A village man stands with empty open hands and a lost, puzzled face; the gold light that should glow around his head is only a faint ring.

two_shot push_in: Agni and Swaha face each other with folded hands inside a ring of marigold light while Brahma, faint behind them, raises his hand in blessing; on 'never' their two fire halos glow as one and light motes rise around them.
